title: LogiCade Prologue
theme: The Kingdom – Library Tower: the royal library tower
learning_objectives: Learn the platform controls, missions, and progression.

points: Read the mission before starting. Learn the controls, Run, Step and Oracle hints.
A new wallet starts with 20 coins. Each hint costs 6 coins; first clears award the configured rewards once.
Stage 2 is guided interface practice; the main flowchart lesson is Week 2.
lesson.title: Orientation

objective: Watch the LogiCade prologue to completion before entering the first learning challenge.
hint: Use the Platform Orientation idea and test one choice against the station goal.
controls: Full-screen video; no pause or skip controls. Click only if sound autoplay is blocked.

tasks.prompt: Watch the LogiCade prologue to learn how to begin.
tasks.explanation: The video completion opens the next stage.
